projects.title: Tally - Kubernetes Cost Allocation Platform
projects.description: $75K annual savings through cost attribution. Built a system that transformed 'mystery cloud bills' into actionable insights. The challenge: 34% of costs were unattributable across shared infrastructure. My solution combined AWS Cost Explorer, Kubecost APIs, and custom EBS volume tagging to achieve 97% cost attribution.

projects.title: DataverseUp - Harvard Research Data Repository
projects.description: Production-ready Kubernetes for Harvard's Dataverse platform. Led containerization for EKS deployments, building custom Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines that aligned with the existing GDCC community patterns—so future maintainers wouldn't need to learn a new approach.

projects.title: InvenioUp - CERN Research Data Platform
projects.description: Containerized CERN's InvenioRDM for Kubernetes deployment. Wrapped the upstream helm-invenio chart matching InvenioRDM's expected patterns—same env vars, same migration scripts. Engineers familiar with the platform can onboard instantly.

projects.title: Cloudflare Edge Protection
projects.description: $0 cost edge protection against AI scrapers. Open-source Terraform modules defending multi-tenant platforms using only Cloudflare free tier. Four-layer defense: WAF rules, rate limiting, Bot Fight Mode, and session-aware caching. Presented at Fedora Showcase April 2026.

projects.title: Hyku - Digital Repository Accessibility
projects.description: WCAG compliance across 100+ routes for Samvera's library platform. Built automated A11y testing infrastructure with axe-core-rspec, route manifest generation, and CI integration. Accessibility isn't optional—it's infrastructure.

projects.title: Notch8-Ops - Enterprise DevOps Framework
projects.description: Multi-cluster Kubernetes infrastructure management. Terraform modules, reusable GitHub Actions workflows, and R&D templates for evaluating hostable software offerings.
